column3: Ayase Route ・ Carnage Arc
...Yeah. I'll see you tomorrow then.
Okay. I'm looking forward to the movie.
Me too.
Hehe... Good night, Onii-san.
Yo, did I make you wait?
No, I just got here.
That movie was really interesting.
I don't really get those romance movies.
Geez...
How about an action movie next time?
Okay, I'm fine with that.
When does it work for you? You've got your modeling job, so I'll fit around your schedule.
Then how about tomorrow?
Okay.
It's a good thing we started dating during summer break.
We can meet everyday.
Yes. That's true.
Oh yeah, how was your date with Kirino in Akiba?
It didn't go so well. Actually, we had a little fight.
What happened?
Well, we were discussing that manga you recommended and we chatted at a maid cafe... So far, so good.
Uh-huh.
Seems like there's some progress at least.
It seems like Kirino thought I'd completely turned into an otaku.
She went completely overboard releasing her otaku power?
Yes. We ended up talking about 【H-games】 for two hours straight.
My sister is one scary person.
Talking about 【H-games】 for two hours with Ayase? Does she have a death wish?
And so you ended up fighting.
It's not really that bad, but... It's still a bit awkward.
Good grief, we've still got a long way to go, huh.
I'm sorry for making you come shopping with me.
It's okay. Here, let me carry that.
Alright, where are we going next?
Can we look around this floor for a little bit longer?
Seems like it's not just my sister who goes shopping for ages.
Then again, she's a model. She should be quite interested in clothes.
Alright, I'll follow your lead.
Yay～
Oh, they're selling swimwear. And we happen to be on summer break.
Hey, why don't we go to the pool?
Geez... You pervert.
...And that's what happened.
Oh, yeah?
Hey...
Oh, right, summer break's over... Hold on a moment.
Hey, listen!
What? Pipe down.
You've been on the phone for ages; who are you talking to?
D-Does it matter?
It does matter.
Why?
Look, you...
Whatever. It's nothing.
Huh?
I said it's nothing!
W-What's up with her? Don't just leave me hanging like that.
I still have to talk to you, so swing by my room later.
What happened?
Nothing, it's just Kirino.
What about Kirino?
Nah, it's nothing important. She just barged in, said she had something to talk to me about, but then just said it's nothing and left.
Say, what do you think it's all about?
She probably means "I need to talk to you right now, Onii-chan".
Eh...
You should go now. You don't have time to be talking to me.
You're exaggerating...
Just do it.
...Alright.
*sigh* She's always so quick to worry when it comes to Kirino.
Hmph. She totally likes Kirino more than me.
